title: Balangao language
description: Austronesian language spoken in the Philippines
extract: Balangao or Balangaw is an Austronesian language spoken in northern Luzon, Philippines. Balangaw is spoken throughout the municipality of Natonin, with the exception of the barangays of Maducayan and Saliok and Barangay Banao. It is also spoken in parts of the neighboring municipality of Paracelis by Balangao settlers.
